subject: FinLynk evaluation: security gate playbook & DPA clarifications
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Zhang <michelle.zhang@finlynk.com>; Procurement <procurement@finlynk.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: FinLynk evaluation: initial security gate checklist and timeline

Hi Michelle / FinLynk team,

Thanks again for taking the call last week — great to hear the product fit is promising. To keep momentum toward a January POC start, I pulled together the initial security gate items we typically bake into a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for customers in regulated payments. High-level asks below; full MAP and artifacts attached.

Key security/compliance gates we expect to close before POC kickoff:
- SOC 2 Type II report review (we've attached our latest report)
- SIG/CAIQ matrix completion for FinLynk questions (we can prefill; request your team to mark residuals)
- DPA redlines and data retention policy (we propose 90/365 options — need decision)
- Evidence access: log and audit snapshots for a 30-day trial window

Proposed timeline (draft MAP milestones):
- Dec 3: FinLynk returns SIG matrix with open items
- Dec 10: Legal finishes DPA redlines or flags exceptions
- Dec 15: Security review sign-off (or list of blockers)
- Jan 4: POC environment activated

Attached: SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2026.pdf (summary), SIG_Matrix_FINLYNK.xlsx (blank prefills), DPA_Redlined_FINLYNK.docx (template)

Open question for you: which retention policy does FinLynk require for POC telemetry — 90 days or 365 days? We can support either, but the DPA needs to reflect the choice.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a formal MAP doc midday tomorrow.

Best,
Priyom
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Michelle Zhang <michelle.zhang@finlynk.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finlynk.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinLynk evaluation: initial security gate checklist and timeline

Hi Priyom — thanks for the clear list and attachments. A couple of quick notes from security/procurement:  

- We'll fill the SIG matrix and return it by Dec 6 (aiming for Dec 4). Expect a handful of residuals around key management and access review.
- On retention: for production we require 365 days, but for the POC we prefer 90 days. Can your DPA accommodate a scoped retention clause for the POC period?
- Procurement will produce an initial redline to your DPA; I'll loop legal if we have substantive changes.

Also can you confirm whether you support HSM-backed key management and whether audit logs include per-request metadata (IP, requester id, timestamp)?

Best,
Michelle
Head of IT Security | FinLynk

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Zhang <michelle.zhang@finlynk.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinLynk evaluation: initial security gate checklist and timeline

Michelle — quick reply on the two items:  

- HSM/KMS: Redwood supports cloud KMS integrations and customer-managed keys for Private deployments. For hosted POC we can provide a KMS-backed option; HSM-level (FIPS/HSM appliance) requires Private deployment or our Dedicated offering — happy to detail tradeoffs.
- Audit logs: yes, our audit logs include per-request metadata (IP, token id, timestamp, model, request size). We can produce scheduled snapshots for your security review.

I'll attach a short runbook page in the MAP that maps "POC retention = 90 days" vs "Production retention = 365 days" with the required legal language. Priyom — can you add the runbook section and a concrete sign-off checkbox for FinLynk security?

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Customer Security | Redwood Inference

Michelle — thanks for the fast turnaround on the SIG matrix and procurement routing. Final clarifications below and next steps so we can reach the security gate by Dec 23.

1) Audit log deletions: for the POC we handle deletions via support ticket with a 3-business-day SLA; for Dedicated/Private we provide an API-based deletion workflow tied to customer-managed KMS. We'll add the 3-business-day SLA (POC) to the MAP runbook and the DPA Annex for clarity.

2) HSM request: for the single HSM ask, we can provide a scoped control in the SIG response that maps to Dedicated options. For the POC we'll provide KMS-backed encryption keys (cloud KMS).

3) DPA: Redwood legal will accept most procurement redlines; a few clauses (data residency, indemnity thresholds) require a short call with legal — propose Dec 22 at 10am PT. Please confirm availability and we'll send a calendar invite/DocuSign link for the final DPA once agreed.

Next steps (MAP closure runbook):
- Dec 21: Redwood posts final MAP doc to Drive with checkboxes for security sign-off
- Dec 22: Legal sync (if needed) to resolve DPA exceptions
- Dec 23: Security acceptance (sign-off) and DocuSign send for DPA
- Jan 4: POC go-live (if all gates closed)

Attachments referenced: SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2026.pdf; SIG_Matrix_FINLYNK.xlsx (completed by FinLynk); DPA_Redlined_FINLYNK.docx (procurement redlines)

Appreciate the collaboration — ping me if you'd like the MAP converted into a shareable checklist for your security stakeholders.

Best,
Priyom
